quickref.status: 2013 launch default (wiki beta name 'Grrnade Launcher'). 2020 wiki edit changed stats. No 2026 playtest sighting: only Steam screen_04 / trailer 26 s, capture date unknown.
quickref.look: Fat octagonal cylinder launcher on the right forearm: riveted white panels framed in orange (#E58D2B lit / #A75C10 shaded), black octagonal muzzle, black ribbed hose arching over the top (two hoses when hanging muzzle-down), small orange fins. About 0.6x Oliver long. No cyan.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Semi-auto lob in an arc. A golden orb forms on the muzzle during reload [Observed]. Projectile is a glowing white-yellow ball (#FBFDDE core) with a yellow-orange comet trail (#ECB235) [Observed, low-res]; 750 u/s (700 before 2020) [Fan-wiki].
quickref.impact_end_result: Explodes on contact into a 'huge and bright' golden orb blast, 45-70 explosive (55-75 before 2020), AoE 125/250 (85/215 before), knocks back airborne players, high self-damage risk [Fan-wiki]. Blast seen only ambiguously (PLZG_TQe9YE hq3). The trailer 26 s blast is a radiation bomb, not this weapon.

quickref.status: 2013 launch, 110,000 J; the wiki called it the default for two weeks before launch (rev 37475 to 40735). Seen in 2026 playtests: official highlights C7uFxvSZ10c, fan jbdhitBvSL8, JustNubz showcase -lAtv-j9Sms.
quickref.look: Long slab arm-gun on the right forearm. Front: orange hexagonal plate with a black window and two white light bars. Back: black core with orange rails and white end panels. Round orange side port; short black barrel with a glowing yellow-orange tip (#FEE995 / #F3BC67). Hangs muzzle-down in store renders. About 0.65x Oliver.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 'will charge for a second before firing an extremely fast, golden laser' [Fan-wiki]. Spiky gold muzzle flare at 0/1 [Observed]. Hitscan pencil-thin lemon-yellow beam (#EDDC31-#F7E95C, pale core) in the promo banner; pale yellow streak in 2026 gameplay [Observed]. 1 shot, 3 s reload. The trailer 1.5 s line is another bear's shot.
quickref.impact_end_result: 'colossal explosion', 'emitting particles and light' and 'a dim light wave'; 75-90 explosive (55-75 before 2020), AoE 90/220 [Fan-wiki]. Pale-yellow spark starburst in the promo banner; white-gold flash in one low-res clip [Observed].

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.3 (Sep 27 2013), 60 gas (v2.7 store). 2.6.1 (Jan 4 2014) fixed a respawn misfire. 2020 edit changed stats; 'Charge Time 3' added 2026-09-20, unsourced. BBH Ultimate per wiki. 2026 unconfirmed.
quickref.look: Short wide orange-and-white cylinder with a grey hexagonal muzzle and a ring of cyan dots. In-game three white fins with glowing cyan panels are always deployed (even at 2/2); only the garage render shows them folded flat. About 0.5x Oliver.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Chargeable energy shotgun: 2 uncharged shots (45) or one full-charge 'single golden burst' (140; 130 before 2020). 'particles converge on the barrel' while charging, 'orbs of light' at the tip when full [Fan-wiki]. Short yellow-gold streaks and a floor glow [Observed, low-res].
quickref.impact_end_result: No AoE or explosive damage [Fan-wiki]; a yellow-white spark burst on the hit target [Observed: 1ykwGM9cCs4 hq3]. Very short range.

quickref.status: Added v2.7 (Jan 23 2014) at 100 gas [Observed, v2.7 store]; 60 gas per the 2020 wiki edit. HUD showed /75 in Jan 2014 and /40 in Nov 2015. 2026 unconfirmed.
quickref.look: Wide orange-and-white drum minigun on the right forearm: stepped concentric rings narrowing to an orange end cap with a black multi-hole port; cyan side window. The 2.7 promo card shows a different multi-barrel design. About 0.5x Oliver.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Full-auto with wind-up and wind-down; 0.08 s rate (0.09 before 2020); dispersion 0.06; hitscan by implication [Fan-wiki; Inference]. 'explosive bullets' [Game text via wiki]. Tracer look unconfirmed: the periwinkle streaks in DNcZwCdJSIk may be Satellite missiles.
quickref.impact_end_result: Tiny explosive pops: 5 + 2-4 explosive per round (8 + 5-7 before 2020), 'noticeable AoE' 50/100 [Fan-wiki]. Not observed.

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.7 (Jan 23 2014), 150,000 J. 3-shot clip seen from 2014 to a Jun 2023 upload (build 2.53.6). 2026 unconfirmed.
quickref.look: Rounded orange-and-white arm cannon with a black octagonal muzzle holding a glowing cyan lens, a cyan dotted light strip on the side and a small black scope on top. About 0.45x Oliver.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Semi-auto, fully accurate, instant hitscan; used like a sniper rifle. 'a purple bolt of damaging energy' [Fan-wiki]. Candidate: a magenta-pink streak with cyan fringes in 7osH2UbN6MM hq3 [Observed; attribution Unverified].
quickref.impact_end_result: No explosion ('What no explosion?' [Game text via wiki]); 50 damage (48 before 2020) [Fan-wiki]. Hit not observed.

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.20 (May 29 2015); level 10 lock; 100 gas then (60 since the 2020 edit); -10% Health modifier. In SkyVu's Facebook post as '-B1000 Bass Cannon' and in the 'Loud & Proud Bundle'. 2026 unconfirmed.
quickref.look: Dark olive/black cylinder with an orange band, dark-blue windows, two black ports, and a speaker/turbine-disc muzzle (white vanes over a pale-blue cone). About 0.45x Oliver.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Continuous fire, 0.25 s per wave; a dubstep loop plays while firing [Fan-wiki]. Nested octagonal semi-transparent cyan-blue rings (#58CAE3 / #4589DC / pale #D8F9FD), each about a bear's torso wide; maroon in one 2.20 clip on a magenta-lit map. 1,200 u/s.
quickref.impact_end_result: Rings pop in small blue-white spark flares [Observed]; 10 + 10-20 explosive, small AoE 75/150 (100/200 before 2020); can rarely blow airborne enemies away [Fan-wiki].

quickref.status: 2013 launch default secondary. The wiki has marked it 'REMOVED' since rev 77032 (2020-11-09); no SkyVu date or patch found. 2026 unconfirmed.
quickref.look: Backpack of two stacked orange boxes with black panels, large dark navy-grey speaker-like discs, small dials and white triangle accents. About 0.45x Oliver. No cyan.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Hold fire to self-destruct: 3 s per the official text, 4 s per wiki prose. Moving cancels it (3.5 s reload). No projectile.
quickref.impact_end_result: B-1000 explodes: 200-400 explosive, AoE 200/400, the highest of any explosive; counts as SUICIDE [Fan-wiki]. Aftermath frame shows the SUICIDE feed and scattered red-and-white chunks [Observed, low-res]. Blast not observed.

quickref.status: 2013 launch (first wiki page 'Leap N Destroy'). 100 gas (v2.7), 70 (2.20 notes), 60 (2020 wiki). In the Steam trailer (footage date unknown).
quickref.look: Back unit of two riveted white wing-like plates over orange perforated sections on a black spine; vents glow orange-yellow before and after a leap. About 0.5x Oliver. No cyan.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Leaps at ~35 degrees at high speed [Fan-wiki]; trailer shows a rocket-exhaust flame jetting backward from the back module [Observed].
quickref.impact_end_result: Left-arm ground smash, 'golden shockwave'; 70-110 explosive (70-90 before 2020), AoE 125/400 (150/300 before); immobile 2.5 s [Fan-wiki]. Trailer 52.4-53.75 s: light column, gold cone over a white octagon, then expanding nested orange octagonal rings with white edges [Observed; B-1000 attribution Inference].

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.3 (pre-release wiki page 'Shield'), 120,000 J. 2020 edit: 2 s duration, 2 charges, 5 s reload. Seen in a 2023 upload and the fan 2026 closed test (jbdhitBvSL8).
quickref.look: Rounded black-and-orange backpack with four white hexagonal pods, each holding a dark round grille, and mirrored white/orange chevrons in the centre. Concept: the shield 'emits from Sides' / 'from top when opened'. No cyan.
quickref.impact_end_result: Player 'glow[s] their team coloured' and takes 50% less damage; no overhead icon; effect stacks [Fan-wiki]. Glow not observed.

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.7, 100,000 J in v2.7. Listed as the default secondary on the wiki since the 2020 edit (cooldown 1 s, reload 3 s). 2026 unconfirmed.
quickref.look: White rounded shield-shaped backpack with a thick orange outline, segmented white panels and a black slatted vent cap on top. No cyan.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Activation from the backpack only; 2 charges, 5 s cloud; no projectile [Fan-wiki].
quickref.impact_end_result: Instantly releases 'a huge, harmless white cloud' [Fan-wiki]. A near-white in-game frame (sxYKPH3GAx0 hq3) is consistent with it [Observed; Inference].

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.7, 100 gas in v2.7 (60 per the 2020 wiki edit). Stub page; missile count conflicts (2 in 2018 text, 8 in 2020 text). 2026 unconfirmed.
quickref.look: Orange octagonal cradle with a dark lower panel on the back, holding a glossy white sphere with a cyan liquid band and two cyan lights. Never shown detached. The 2.7 card's cyan-lensed orange probe does not match it.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 'fires missiles whenever he fires' [Game text via wiki]; 2 or 8 missiles per load per conflicting wiki revisions; 1,500 u/s. Possible pale periwinkle missile streaks in DNcZwCdJSIk [Observed; attribution Unverified].
quickref.impact_end_result: Explosive missiles: 20-50 with AoE 125/250 (2020 wiki) or 25-45 with 100/250 (2018 wiki). Not clearly observed.

quickref.status: 2013 launch default melee; page names 'Ax time' then 'Axe Time' (May 2013). 2020 wiki edit raised damage 30 to 70. 2026 unconfirmed.
quickref.look: Left forearm ends in a grey stone-textured axe head with a hammer back and a big curved, scratched grey-white blade; white ribbed sleeve, orange octagonal cuff and fin. NO glow, no cyan. About 0.5x Oliver.
quickref.impact_end_result: 70 damage [Fan-wiki]; swing not observed. Kills follow the break-apart house style [Inference].

quickref.status: 2013 launch, 45,000 J; signature promo melee. 2020 edit: 50 dmg/+10% to 45 dmg/+30% special speed. Probable cyan claw tips in the fan 2026 closed test. BBH attack per wiki.
quickref.look: Left-forearm black/orange/white gauntlet with three long translucent cyan blades (#2BDCF1 with white streaks) and a looping white hose with cyan rings. About 0.6x Oliver.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Rising swing; no projectile; no electric effect documented.
quickref.impact_end_result: Trailer kill: a light column, then a green-furred bear carrying the coral Bearzooka (a Soldier, probably the Green Oliver skin [Inference]; not a Demo) breaks into chunky pieces that fly upward [Observed]. The orange streaks are probably trailer overlay [Inference].

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.21 (Jul 3 2015), level 5. Modifier and price conflict: -10% health/+10% special speed, 75 gas (2016 wiki) vs +10% health, 60 gas (2020 wiki). A matching silver/pink blade appears in two 2026 thumbnails (identity Inference).
quickref.look: Long flat angular silver blade (#B6B3B9) with hot-pink edge trim (#D91052) and a pale-cyan inner line (#CDDBDE); silver-grey X-shaped crossguard (#7F7E82-#A4AAA8) with pink trim (#B01B47). Longest B-1000 weapon, about 1.0x Oliver.
quickref.impact_end_result: 85 damage, the highest melee in BBG [Fan-wiki]; hit not observed.

quickref.status: Only on the 2013 concept sheet 'B-1000 PRIMARY ATTACKS'; nothing shows it shipped [Inference].
quickref.look: Grey concept sketch of B-1000 with no weapon in that pose.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Twin red laser beams from the eyes [Observed: concept art].

Which of the 14 B-1000 weapons ship in the Nov 4 2026 build? Only the Bearail Gun, Energy Barrier, a probable Shock N Claw and a probable Primus Sword appear in 2026 thumbnails; the Grenader (launch default) has no 2026 sighting.
What does the Grenader blast look like on camera, and how big is it? What is the 'rotating or orbiting' element of its shell?
Is the magenta-pink streak in 7osH2UbN6MM hq3 (2023) the Lightning Bolt's 'purple bolt', or wall graffiti?
What do SRCG rounds and impacts look like? Was its launch clip 75 (Jan 2014 HUD) rather than 40? Are the periwinkle streaks in DNcZwCdJSIk SRCG rounds or Satellite missiles?

Satellite: does it fire 2 missiles (2018 wiki text) or 8 (2020 wiki text)? What do the missiles look like, does the orb ever leave its cradle, and what is the cyan-lensed orange probe on the 2.7 promo card?
Metal Crush: is the Steam trailer's 52.0-53.75 s landing ring (gold cone, then nested orange octagonal rings) definitely an orange-skin B-1000, and how does its size relate to the wiki's 125/400 AoE?
What do the Energy Barrier team-colour glow and the Smoke Screen cloud's volume look like in-game?
Bass Cannon: are the rings team-coloured, or is the maroon in XFFksUDewpE map lighting? Why does the 2015-2016 HUD read /31 when the wiki says 20?
Energy Overflow: do the fins ever fold in-game, or only in the garage render?
Primus Sword: is the modifier -10% health / +10% special speed (2016 wiki) or +10% health (2020 wiki)? The 2015 '198/198' clip also had Armour+1, so it does not settle this.
Steam trailer: is the light column in the claw kill an in-game effect? Is the B-1000 footage from 2013 or newer?
Grenader clip history (/4, /6 or /8, /6, /3): which readings include Ammo+ equipment, and what was the base clip in each era?
BBH: is 'Slice n Bite' a copy error (the wiki lists Huggy's attack as 'Slice-n-Bite'), and what is the official name of B1000's stun Ultimate?
